summary: Closed T35 F-002: replaced the two SecurityGate-to-exit-code denylists in src/commands/security.ts (exitCodeFor for `security scan`/`check-*`, and handleReport's inline fold for `security report`) with a single exhaustive allowlist predicate (isPassGate) shared by both, so a needs-approval gate now refuses in ci mode the same as it already did in enforced mode, and an unrecognized gate value refuses instead of falling through to pass. Advisory permissiveness and the three-way fail/needs-approval/incomplete distinction in the printed/JSON output are unchanged. Two existing security.check-input.test.ts assertions that encoded the old (buggy) ci behavior were corrected to match the fix, and a new security-gate-exit.test.ts adds 16 regression tests (direct unit coverage of the exhaustive default arm plus CLI-level reproductions of the reviewer's T35-probe-cli.ts case E4 and T35-probe-cli2.ts ci row). handleReport's strict check stays ci-only (not widened to enforced), reproducing F-002's own suggested fix rather than making an independent scope decision; src/commands/health.ts has the identical denylist shape over a different gate vocabulary and is out of this task's ownership, so it was reported, not fixed, and flagged as a separate background task.

findings.problem: runExitCode(status, strict) is the same denylist shape T35 F-002 reported for src/commands/security.ts: `status === "fail" || status === "incomplete" || (strict && status === "warn") ? 1 : 0`. An unrecognized future `health` gate status falls through to 0 (a false pass) instead of refusing.
findings.impact: If a future health gate status is added without updating this fold, `keryx health run --strict` would exit 0 for it instead of refusing, the same class of bug as F-002 (an unrecognized/blocking value reads as a clean exit). Not exploitable today since the health gate's status union is presently closed, but the shape is latent.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite as an allowlist over the one non-blocking status the way T38 rewrote src/commands/security.ts's exitCodeFor/reportExitCode: exhaustive switch over the recognized health gate statuses with the default arm refusing.
findings.evidence: bun src/cli.ts ctx rg -n "function runExitCode" src/commands/health.ts, then read src/commands/health.ts:90-94 directly. Not executed against a live unrecognized status since the health gate's status type is closed today; found by shape comparison against the fixed exitCodeFor/reportExitCode.
